construction_attempted: Run-56 noisy affine transport with deliberately singular/underdetermined branch differences; complete-output endpoint row-span synthesis audit
proved_claims: For a true targeted affine-transport instance, the endpoint functional R_L-R_0 T lies in the public row span of the complete noiseless transport operator.

Therefore a witness-free evaluator Q with Q M=L_T can be found by public Gaussian elimination and exactly recovers the programmed endpoint carrier on a noiseless transcript, without branch-difference inversion or frame recovery.
For arbitrary additive error, every such evaluator obeys Q C=S_K+Q E.
For real iid Gaussian transcript error, the public minimum-Euclidean-norm evaluator has per-output noise standard deviation no larger than any honest path evaluator.
explicit_nonclaims: No attack on standard modular LWE is claimed.
No theorem that every modular noisy affine transport has a short public evaluator is claimed.
No generic-NP surviving compiler is claimed.
No arbitrary-QPT early-key-recovery to source-witness/SIS reduction is claimed.
Finite tests are not security evidence.
handoff: Exact affine transport is closed even when every branch difference is deliberately singular. The only potentially surviving affine direction is a modular short-evaluator gap: valid witnesses give short structured endpoint evaluators while public synthesis yields decoding-useless modular coefficients, with the complete-output gap reduced non-circularly to SIS/LWE or another independently justified PQ assumption.
